word: Title: Evening At Home
answer: Tarde En Casa

word: I speak with my sister in the kitchen.
answer: "Hablo con mi hermana en la cocina."

word: You take a cold drink from the fridge. [sing, inf]
answer: "Tomas una bebida fría del refri."

word: We work together to prepare dinner.
answer: "Trabajamos juntos para preparar la cena."

word: They eat early because they are hungry.
answer: "Ellos comen temprano porque tienen hambre."

word: I live with my family in this house.
answer: "Vivo con mi familia en esta casa."

word: She takes the plates to the table.
answer: "Ella lleva los platos a la mesa."

word: He arrives tired after a long day.
answer: "Él llega cansado después de un día largo."

word: You call your mom to ask about the recipe. [sing, inf]
answer: "Llamas a tu mamá para preguntar por la receta."

word: We listen to soft music while cooking.
answer: "Escuchamos música suave mientras cocinamos."

word: They see the food getting ready.
answer: "Miran la comida que ya se está preparando."

word: I buy tortillas from the corner store.
answer: "Compro tortillas de la tiendita de la esquina."

word: You search for the salt in the cabinet. [sing, inf]
answer: "Buscas la sal en el gabinete."

word: We need more onions for the salsa.
answer: "Necesitamos más cebolla para la salsa."

word: He asks if dinner is almost ready.
answer: "Él pregunta si la cena ya casi está lista."

word: They wait patiently at the table.
answer: "Ellos esperan pacientemente en la mesa."

word: She changes the music to something calm.
answer: "Ella cambia la música a algo tranquilo."

word: We walk to the patio after dinner.
answer: "Caminamos al patio después de cenar."

word: I pass by the living room to grab a book.
answer: "Paso por la sala para agarrar un libro."

word: You enter the kitchen to wash dishes. [sing, inf]
answer: "Entras a la cocina para lavar los trastes."

word: I must finish some work tonight.
answer: "Debo terminar un poco de trabajo esta noche."

word: They believe the evening feels peaceful.
answer: "Ellos creen que la tarde se siente tranquila."

word: We learn new recipes every week.
answer: "Aprendemos recetas nuevas cada semana."

word: She writes her favorite ones in a notebook.
answer: "Ella escribe sus favoritas en un cuaderno."

word: You travel to visit your parents often. [sing, inf]
answer: "Viajas seguido para visitar a tus papás."

word: We help clean the kitchen together.
answer: "Ayudamos a limpiar la cocina juntos."

word: I am going to read on the patio later.
answer: "Voy a leer en el patio más tarde."

word: They are going to watch a movie soon.
answer: "Ellos van a ver una película pronto."

word: We are going to sleep early tonight.
answer: "Vamos a dormir temprano esta noche."
